paite: Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuanglui Ni, Paikan Ankuangluina kichi anaita hi.
heading: Judas Iskariot Lehpanna / (Mat 26.1-5; Mar 14.1-2; Joh 11.45-53)
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

paite: Siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n hihlup theihna ding dan azong ua, vantang lah akihta ngal ua.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

paite: Sawm-le-nihte lak a pang, Judas, Iskariot kichi sung ah Setan alut hi.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

paite: Huchi in amah ava pai a siampu liante leh heutute kiang ah zuausan a matsak theihna ding dan ava kihoupih hi.
english: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

paite: Amau akipak mahmah ua, akiang ah dangka piak achiamta uhi.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

paite: Ama'n lem asa a, mipi om louh kal a zuausan a matsakna lemtang azongta hi.
english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

paite: Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ni, Paikan Ankuangluina belamnou gohna ding ni ahong tungta hi.
heading: Paikan Ankuang Nanung / (Mat 26.17-25; Mar 14.12-21; Joh 13.21-30)
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n, "Peter leh Johan asawl a, Paikan Ankuang i nek ding hon va bawlsak un," chi in.
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Koi ah va bawl le ung na ut a?” achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ngai un, khopi a na lut un, pasal, bel a tui tawi in ahon tuak ding a, alutna inn ah zui lut un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

paite: Inn neipa kiang ah, "Sinsakpa'n, ka nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka nekna ding uh, mikhual inn pindan koi lai ahia ahon chi, na chi ding uh.
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

paite: Huchi in ama'n indan tungnung zapi, van omsa, ahon ensak ding; huai ah hih un," achi hi.
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

paite: Huan ahohta ua, akiang ua agen bangtak in amuta ua; huan Paikan Ankuang ava bawl uhi.
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

paite: Huan anek hun in, dohkan um in atu a, asawltakte toh a-um uhi.
heading: Ankuang Siangthou / (Mat 26.26-30; Mar 14.22-26; 1 Kor 11.23-25)
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Ka thuak ding ka thuak ma in hiai Paikan Ankuang hon nekpih ka ut mahmah hi.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

paite: K'on hilh ahi, hiai Pathian lalgam a atak a hihtangtun ahih masiah, ka ne nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan nou ala a, kipahthu agen khit in, "Hiai la unla, kihawm un;
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

paite: k'on hilh ahi, tuban Pathian lalgam ahong tun masiah grepgui gahtui ka dawn nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

paite: Huan tanghou ala a, kipahthu agen khit in abalkham a, akiang uah apia a, "Hiai ka pumpi ahi, na sik ua piak ding pen; keimah theihgigena in hih zel un,” achi hi.
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

paite: Huchibang in nitak an nek zoh in nou ala a, "Hiai nou ka sisan a thukhun thak, na sik ua pawt ding pen."
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

paite: "Himahleh ngai un, zuausan a hon mansak dingpa khut ka kiang ah dohkan tung ah a-omta hi.
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

paite: Mihing Tapa seh a a-om bangtak in apai ding hi, himahleh zuausan a mansak dingpa mihing tung agik hi!" achi hi.
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

paite: Huan amau lak ah, "Huchibang thilhih ding kua ahi dia le?" chi in akidongtuah uhi.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

paite: Huan alak uah kua pen ahia thupipen a seh chih thu ah, kiselna ahong pawt hi.
heading: Thupina Thu A Kiselna
english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Zentel kumpipate atung uah thu anei gige ua, atung ua thuneite thil hoih hihsakte in angai uhi.
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

paite: Himahleh nou zaw huchibang na hi kei ding uh; na lak ua thupipen nauzaw bang in om henla, makaipen leng nasempen bang in om zaw hen.
english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

paite: Kua ahia thupizaw, dohkan a an um hia, an pepa? Dohkan a an um pen ahi zaw kei maw? Himahleh kei zaw na lak uah nasempa bang in ka om hi.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

paite: "Ze-etna ka tuah sung noute kei hon ompihte na hi uh.
english: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

paite: Huchi in kei, ka Pa'n gam ahon sehsak bang in gam ka hon sehsak ahi.
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

paite: Ka gam a ka dohkan a na nek ua na dawntheihna ding un; huchi in Israel nam sawm-le-nih vai hawmsak in laltutphah ah na hong tu ding uhi.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

paite: "Simon, Simon, ngai in, Setan in buhsep bang a ahon septheihna ding in, noute ahon ngen hi.
heading: Peter Kitheihmohbawl Ding Genkholhna / (Mat 26.31-36; Mar 14.27-31; Joh 13.36-38)
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

paite: Himahleh na ginna amanlouhna ding in ka hon thumsak hi; na kihei nawn chiang in nang na unaute hihkip in," achi hi.
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Toupa, na kiang ah suangkul ah leh sihna ah leng pai sam ngap ka hi,” achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

paite: "Ama'n Peter, ka hon hilh ahi, na hon theihna ah thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl masiah tuni in ak akhuang kei ding,” achi hi.
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Dangka ip lou, kawlzal lou leh khedap lou a ka hon sawlkhiak in bang na tasam ua?" achi hi. Amau, "Bangmah,” achi uhi.
heading: Hong Tung Ding Kidouna
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Tu'n zaw dangka ip nei in keng henla, kawlzal toh, kuapeuh namsau nei lou in apuan zuak henla, lei hen.
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, amah talekte lak ah simtel ahi, chi a kigelh ka tung ah ahong tung ahi; ka tungtang thu tungkim ngei ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

paite: Huan amau, "Toupa, en dih, hiai ah namsau nih a-om," achi ua. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ahun,” achi hi.
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

paite: Huan amah apawt a, angeina dan in Olive tang ah ahohta a; nungzuite'n leng azui uhi.
heading: Gethsemani Huan A Jesu Thumna / (Mat 26.36-46; Mar 14.32-42)
english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

paite: Amun ava tun un, akiang uah, "Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un thum un,” achi hi.
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

paite: Huan suang a denphak tan vel ah ava paituam hi.
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

paite: Huan akhukdin a, athum a, "Pa, hoih na sakleh ka kiang a pan hiai nou lasuan in; himahleh kei thu hilou in, nangmah thu hi zaw hen," achi hi.
english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

paite: Huan van a kipan angel khat amah hihhat ding in akiang ah ahong kilak hi.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

paite: Huan agim mahmah a, phatuamngai nawn sem in athum a; sisan bang in akho-ul mal liantak in lei ah atakkheta hi.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

paite: Huan athum khit a athoh in, nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai a, alungkham ziak un ana ihmu uh amu hi.
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Bangziak a ihmu na hi ua? Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un thou unla, thum un," achi hi.
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

paite: Huan huai agen laitak in, ngai dih, mipi ahong pai ua, sawm-le-nihte lak a tel Judas in ama uh akai a; tawp tum in Jesu ahon zuan hi.
heading: Jesu Matna / (Mat 26.47-56; Mar 14.43-50; Joh 18.3-11)
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Judas, Mihing Tapa tawp a mansak ding na hi maw?" achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

paite: Huan akim a mite'n thil hong tung ding atheih un, "Toupa, namsau in ka sat ding uam?" achi uhi.
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

paite: Huan alak ua kuahiam in siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil taklam asatkhiaksak hi.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

paite: Huan Jesu'n, "Hih nawn ke'n," achi a, abil akhoih a, ahihdamta hi.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

paite: Jesu'n akiang a hong siampu liante tempul heutute leh upate kiang ah, "Namsau leh khetbuk tawi in, suamhat man ding bang hial in na hong kuan uh maw?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

paite: Tempul a na kiang ua niteng a ka om lai in hon mat tum in na hon sawk kei ua; himahleh tu mial thuneihna toh na tat hun uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

paite: Huan aman ua, api ua, siampu lianpen inn ah apilut uhi. Peter in gamlapi ah azui hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Kitheihmohbawl / (Mat 26.57-58,69-75; Mar 14.53-54,66-72; 288 LL Joh 18.12-18,25-27)
english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

paite: Huan inn huangsung intual ah mei achih ua, atukhawm ua, alak uah Peter ava tu sam hi.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

paite: Huan meivak nuai a atut lai in nungak kuahiam in amu a, a-en nilouh a, "Hiai mi leng akiang a om ahi,” achi hi.
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Numei, amah ka thei kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi.
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

paite: Aden chiang deuh in midang in ahong mu nawn a, "Nang leng alak ua mi na hi ve," achi hi. Peter in bel, "Mihing aw, ka hi kei,” achi hi.
english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

paite: Huan dakkal khat phial nung in, midang in, "Hiai mi leng akiang a om ahi tham hi; Galili gammi ahi," achi tinten hi.
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

paite: Huan Peter in, "Mihing aw, na thugen ka thei kei," achi hi. Huan thakhat in, apau laitak in ak ahong khuangta hi.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

paite: Huan Toupa akihei a, Peter a-en hi. Peter in, "Ak khuan ma in thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding, chi a Toupa'n akiang a athugen ahon phawkkhe thak hi."
english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

paite: Huan apawt a, akap huphup hi.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

paite: Jesu lente'n nuihza bawlna in azang ua, asat uhi.
heading: Jesu Nuihsanna Leh Vuakna / (Mat 26.67-68; Mar 14.65)
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

paite: Amit atuamsak ua, "Kua ahia hon sat, gen in?" chi in adong uhi.
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

paite: Thudang tampi in leng agensia un akou uhi.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

paite: Huan khua avaktak in upa hon, siampu liante leh laigelhmite ahong kikhawm ua, avaihawmna uah api uhi.
heading: Juda Vaihawmpawlte Ma A Jesu Pina / (Mat 26.59-66; Mar 14.55-64; Joh 18.19-24)
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

paite: "Khrist na hihleh hon hilh in," achi uhi. Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hon hilh mah leng na gingta kei ding uh.
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

paite: Ke'n noute thu hon dong hita leng leng, na hon dawng kei ding ua, na hon khah sam kei ding uh.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

paite: Himahleh tuban siah Mihing Tapa, Pathian thilhihtheihna taklam ah atuta ding," achi hi.
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

paite: Huan avek un, "Nang Pathian Tapa na hi maw le?" achi ua. Ama'n akiang uah, "Hi e, na hon chih bang un," achi hi.
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

paite: Huan amau, "Bang theihpihna dang i deih lai dia? Eimah mah in amah kamsuak a pan i zata ve ua le,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
